name.description: The palette's name (unique; cues refer to it as "@name")

magicq.description: The MagicQ palettes this palette is (MagicQ's palette ids: type * 4096 + entry); kept for the next export

additionalProperties.description: A number (intensity %, degrees, ...), a slot or set name ("Stars"), a function and its value ("Shutter1Strobe 5"), an exact DMX value ("dmx 37", or after a readable value: "Stars (dmx 37)"), or a palette ("@Front")

heads.description: Per head number: the palette's values (intensity in %, GDTF attributes in their units, slot names)
